name: Nakanohito Genome [Jikkyouchuu]
original_title: ナカノヒトゲノム【実況中】
description: Iride Akatsuki and seven other charismatic game streamers wake up in the world of a mysterious free-to-play game called Naka no Hito Genome. Now they are competing in real-life games with life-or-death stakes, but clearing several game tasks could earn them 100 million lives.
